|errata_history=This is the original printed text of [[Lone Rogue (V)]] (version 1 of 1). The image here is the Players Committee card image as first published. This is the current text. Every published image or slip that differs visibly from the one before is a version, numbered in release order; a printed errata mark that does not match that order is recorded as a PC transcription error (Bill, 12 November 2026). A same-words slip on a Players Committee release sheet and the PC card image it reprints are one version on one article (Bill, 17 November 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): Players Committee card image first published 2 October 2023<ref name="ht-88182de">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual22-Light/large/lonerogue.gif</code> as published 2 October 2023: [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/88182de5459f1ffeeb3856f4ece24e2f4c6a7437/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual22-Light/large/lonerogue.gif holotable commit 88182de] “Fixing case and making gifs” (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “LOST: If your [Hoth] objective on table, take Dack or Wes into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. STARTING: If a [Hoth] objective on table, deploy Echo Base Garrison and two Effects that deploy for free and are always immune to Alter. Place Interrupt in Lost Pile.”
*: The lower part of this version's card image (the bars and game-text box down to the lower-left name) was also printed as a partial slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 22 release sheet<ref name="sheet22-20231006">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-22.pdf Virtual Set 22 release sheet] (PDF, 5 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, October 2023”; file created 6 October 2023).
